Shell.Footer: A new home for the moments you kept.
Shell.ConnectTitle: Your recordings have a next chapter.
Shell.ConnectDescription: Connect your recorder over the home network, open its USB disk or use a complete disk image. Bring your recordings into your own archive.
Shell.UsbDescription: Plug in the disk that holds your Panasonic recordings.
Shell.ChooseDiskHelp: Select the Panasonic recorder disk from the list, or refresh to find a newly connected disk.
Shell.NoDisks: No matching disks yet. Connect your drive, then refresh.
Shell.AdminHelp: Some physical disks require administrator access. Restart only if the disk cannot be opened.
Shell.ImageHelp: Continue from a complete RAW disk image: .img, .dd or .raw.
Shell.ChooseImageHelp: Browse to a complete disk image or enter its path.
Shell.ImageReadOnly: Disk images can be opened without administrator access. Your image file stays unchanged.
Shell.KeepDisk: Keep your recorder disk as it is
Shell.KeepDiskHelp: If Windows offers to initialize or format it, dismiss that message. AMG DIGA Archive reads your source without changing it.
Shell.Compatibility: Recorder compatibility depends on its disk format. Encrypted formats cannot be decrypted. A source container may hold more than one programme.
Shell.SourceReady: Source ready. Select videos to inspect or export.
Shell.NetworkAccessHelp: Check the output folder permissions. Network downloads do not require administrator access.
Shell.DiskAccessHelp: For a physical recorder disk, use Restart as administrator on the Connect page. Also check the output folder permissions.
Shell.AdminDescription: Windows requires elevated access to read some physical disks. DIGA will restart and continue to open disks read-only. Save settings before restarting; the order number and selections are not retained.
Shell.NetworkSourceInfo: Choose a network recording to inspect or preview.
Shell.ExportVerified: FFprobe verified matching stream counts and codecs.
Shell.SettingsDescription: Set your defaults once. Connect OneDrive whenever you're ready.
Shell.DifferentOutput: You can choose a different destination each time you preserve recordings.
Shell.GuideNext: Guide me to the next step
Shell.GuideDescription: Move from Connect to Discover when a source opens, and from Preserve to Archive when your copies are ready.
Shell.GuideManual: You can always move between steps yourself using the journey navigation.
Shell.CacheDescription: Short previews and temporary source copies are stored here. Disk export stages one full original at a time and removes it after a successful export. Clear this session's cache to remove remaining preview files.
Shell.ClearCacheHelp: This removes this session's temporary originals and preview clips. Preserved output files are kept.
Shell.ToolsDescription: FFmpeg, FFprobe and MediaInfoLib are included in the installer. Choose other compatible x64 tools only if needed.
Shell.CloudDescription: Optional. Sign in through your browser; upload preserved copies from Archive when you choose.
Shell.NotConnected: Not connected. Choose Connect OneDrive and sign in with your Microsoft account.
Shell.BuiltInClient: Leave this empty to use the application ID built into the app ({0}). Enter an ID only if you registered your own application with Microsoft.
Shell.MicrosoftSetupDescription: Not needed with the built-in application ID. To use your own instead, register an application in Microsoft Entra (Entra ID → App registrations → New registration). Under Supported account types choose "Any Entra ID Tenant + Personal Microsoft accounts" (older label: "Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts"); any other choice blocks personal OneDrive. Add the redirect http://localhost under Mobile and desktop applications, create no client secret, and paste the application (client) ID above.
Shell.MicrosoftPermissions: Delegated permissions: Files.ReadWrite and offline_access. A desktop public client does not use a client secret.
Shell.MicrosoftSetupLink: Microsoft's guide to registering an application ↗
Shell.CloudSaveHelp: Connecting and disconnecting also save your settings. Disconnect removes the locally saved sign-in; so does changing the application ID. Detailed setup instructions are included in docs/MEDIA-CLOUD.md.
Shell.PreferencesSavedHelp: Your defaults are ready for this session and the next time you open AMG DIGA Archive.
Shell.AboutDescription: A native Windows application for preserving compatible Panasonic recorder video, built with WinUI 3, panasonic-rec, FFmpeg and MediaInfoLib.
Shell.ProjectLink: AMG DIGA Archive · project and releases ↗
Shell.LicenseNotice: Licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. The read-only filesystem reader is based on leecher1337's panasonic-rec. Third-party notices and source provenance are included. Panasonic is a trademark of its owner; this project is independent.
